column1: # The v2 format: one `point` per line
# in ascending time order. `seconds` is measured from the start of the shot
#   ramp — pressure moves linearly from the previous point to this one
#   jump — the previous pressure is held until this point's time
# This profile holds 3 bar for the pre-infusion
# then ramps down to 6 and holds that until the shot ends.
